data.one_liner: A simple Dio log interceptor with coloring features and JSON formatting.
data.what_it_does: It acts as a Dio interceptor to log HTTP requests and responses in a readable, colorful, and formatted manner. It supports JSON formatting, minimized outputs, and pretty FormData support for fields and files.
use_when: You want readable, color-coded HTTP request and response logs in your Dio-based app
You need to log FormData fields and files nicely during development
avoid_when: You do not use Dio for networking
You require a heavy-weight network inspector UI tool rather than console logging
strengths: Provides colored and JSON-formatted output for better readability
Supports pretty printing of FormData fields and files
Allows minimizing header and timeout logs to reduce clutter
weaknesses: Limited to console logging without an in-app visual inspector GUI

alternatives.name: dio
alternatives.why_pick_it: Dio has a built-in LogInterceptor if you do not need the specific formatting and coloring of this package.
